extracted.intended_audience: librarians, literary scholars, editors, and writers tracking magazine publication and selective indexing of short stories
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and methodology for selecting, marking, ranking, and indexing 'stories of distinction' published in American magazines between October 1919 and September 1920, including how magazines are averaged and ranked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asterisk distinction system
rubrics_metrics.description: One, two, and three asterisks are employed to indicate relative distinction of stories; three-asterisk stories are of somewhat permanent literary value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Asterisks are prefixed to titles to indicate distinction. Three asterisks entitle a story to a place on the annual 'Rolls of Honor'. The list of distinguished stories excludes reprints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and timeframe for indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: All short stories published in the listed magazines and newspapers from October 1919 to September 1920 inclusive are indexed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The index covers a specified set of American periodicals and newspapers (explicitly listed). In addition, a separate index lists 'short stories of distinction only' published in another set of magazines during the same period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion/exclusion of reprints and translations
rubrics_metrics.description: The lists exclude reprints but do not exclude translations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When counting or marking distinctive stories and compiling indexes, reprints are omitted from consideration; translations are included and counted toward a magazine's totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-American author notation
rubrics_metrics.description: An asterisk before an author's name indicates that he/she is not an American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a prefixed asterisk on author names to mark non-American authors in the index entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of (H) notation
rubrics_metrics.description: (H) after an author's name indicates that other stories by this author, published in American magazines between 1900 and 1914, are indexed in 'The Standard Index of Short Stories' by Francis J. Hannigan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include (H) where applicable to cross-reference presence in the Standard Index (publisher and year given in explanatory note).

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine averages and ranking methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute averages of periodicals (Oct. 1919–Sept. 1920) showing number of stories published, number of distinctive stories, and percentage of distinctive stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables present both percentage-of-distinctive-stories ranking and ranking by absolute number of distinctive stories. The periodicals considered are those within the compiler's scope; relative distinction indicated by asterisks factors into these counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thresholds for special lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate lists identify periodicals meeting numeric or percentage thresholds (e.g., periodicals with an average of 15% distinctive stories, those with 10+ two-asterisk stories, and those with five or more three-asterisk stories).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These thresholds determine inclusion in the respective summary lists. Prefix letters (a, b, c, d, e) indicate appearance in earlier years' lists (1915–1919) as noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tie-breaking rule for ranks
rubrics_metrics.description: Ties in ranking lists are decided by taking relative rank in other lists into account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When two or more periodicals tie on one list, consult their relative positions in the alternate ranking(s) (e.g., number vs. percentage lists) to decide order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviation and citation conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard abbreviations are used for periodicals and index entries; figures in parentheses after titles refer to volume and page number of the magazine; where successive numbers are not paged consecutively, only the page number is given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A long keyed list of abbreviations (Adv, Ain, All, Am, Arg, etc.) is provided and must be applied consistently. Parenthetical figures follow the convention described to help locate original items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection note: 'stories of distinction' vs. full indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: Some portions of the index include every short story in listed magazines (comprehensive indexing), while other lists/indexes include only 'short stories of distinction'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be explicit which index/list an entry belongs to: comprehensive index (all stories in listed periodicals) or the selective index (only stories marked with one/two/three asterisks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation for cross references to previous volumes
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross references after an author's name refer to previous volumes of this series; asterisks and prefixed symbols are used in these cross references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the indicated notation and parenthetical volume/page references to link authors and stories to prior volumes where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation indicator across years
rubrics_metrics.description: Prefix letters (a, b, c, d, e) indicate representation of a periodical in lists for the years 1915, 1916, 1917, 1918, and 1919 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these prefixes in the lists summarizing multi-year representation to show continuity of a periodical's presence in the compiler's distinguished lists.
